units.source_text: 我何尝不想飞往东京去吊唁呢。

en.t: It was not that I did not want to fly to Tokyo to pay my respects.

units.source_text: 老师每月充其量只给我五百元零花钱。

en.t: The teacher gave me at most only five hundred yen a month for pocket money.

units.source_text: 母亲本来就很穷，一年预多给我寄一两回钱，每回约奖二三百元。

en.t: My mother had always been very poor, and at most she sent me money once or twice a year, about two or three hundred yen each time.

units.source_text: 母亲所以清理了家产而寄居在加往郡的伯父家，

en.t: The reason my mother disposed of the family property and went to live at my uncle's house in Kayo District

units.source_text: 也是因为父亲死后她仅靠施主每月捐献不足五百元的救济米和政府发给的少得可怜的补助费难以为继的缘故。

en.t: was also that after my father's death she could not get by on the relief rice worth less than five hundred yen that the parishioners donated each month and the pitifully small subsidy from the government.
